verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance sells registered-agent service at a published $99/year rate, with multi-year purchase options (docs-23). Its registered-agent page says customers can 'instantly access state forms pre-filled with our registered agent address for simplified filing' (docs-21), which covers the core need of getting a usable agent address right away for a formation or change filing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an online self-serve checkout flow, explicit mention that the exact agent name is provided alongside the street address, and independent or hands-on corroboration that details arrive the same day.
